newsitem.title: LATVIA: Lukoil sees 2 mln tonnes a year via Ventspils.
newsitem.headline: Lukoil sees 2 mln tonnes a year via Ventspils.

text.p: The Baltic subsidiary of Russian oil giant Lukoil said on Monday said that the company will transport two million tonnes of crude and oil products a year during 1997 and 1998 via Latvia's Ventspils Nafta terminal.
"I have given guarantees to Ventspils that Lukoil will transport not less than two million tonnes a year for the coming two years," Khaim Kogan, general director of Lukoil Baltija, told Reuters.
"Some 900,000 tonnes or 15 percent of the 3.57 million tonnes of crude and oil products transited through Ventspils in 1996 were provided by Lukoil," Kogan said.
He pointed out that Lukoil was one of the clients of the Ventspils terminal, a main outlet for Russian crude oil.
"In the first four months of 1997, Lukoil sent 1.05 million tonnes of oil and oil products through Ventspils, which is a 20-30 percent rise against the whole of 1995," Kogan said.
"We saw some 2.33 million tonnes in 1995 going through Ventspils, 337,000 tonnes of that being diesel," Kogan added.
"This year we have seen a drop in diesel, only some 24,000 tonnes during the first four months of this year," Kogan said.
